rfqs.title: Bulk ppKTP for bidirectional Type-II SPDC
rfqs.candidate: Custom configuration; manufacturer order code to be assigned

requirements.requirement: Collinear Type-II, nominal vacuum pump wavelength 405 nm, degenerate 810+810 nm. Bulk crystal. Same crystal pumped from both ends in a polarization Sagnac. Measured pump wavelength and drift are pending.
requirements.evidence_requested: Confirm interaction tensor, propagation axis, pump/signal/idler polarizations and feasible wavelength range. Do not fix the poling period from nominal wavelength alone.

requirements.requirement: Optical length 10 mm; usable poled clear aperture at least 1 x 2 mm. Input/output faces at normal incidence.
requirements.evidence_requested: Dimensioned drawing, length/aperture tolerances, wedge, edge exclusion, surface quality and mount datum.

requirements.requirement: Poling period to be calculated by supplier for measured pump and achievable operating temperature. Approximately 10 µm is only a literature starting point.
requirements.evidence_requested: Actual period/reference temperature, duty cycle, useful poled region, domain uniformity and serial-specific certificate; distinguish calculated and measured data.

requirements.requirement: Initial controller design 20-60 °C, heating and cooling. System temperature-deviation target±0.05 °C during 2400 s run.
requirements.evidence_requested: T_QPM(λp), tuning slope and acceptance width. Identify if proposed crystal requires a different temperature window; sensor location, gradient and settling recommendations.

requirements.requirement: CW, total incident crystal power P_CW+P_CCW=0.1-3 mW; search waist radius 100-180 µm per axis (1/e² intensity). Per-direction balance is adjustable.
requirements.evidence_requested: Allowed CW405-nm intensity, absorption/heating and long-term degradation. Maximum incident power remains conditional on the actual source and interlock;1064-nm pulsed LIDT is not sufficient.

requirements.requirement: Provide CW and CCW predictions or measurements at the same T and λp, resolving orthogonal signal/idler components.
requirements.evidence_requested: λs, λi, FWHM and temperature slopes; raw CSV with resolution/instrument response. Provide temporal walk-off/group delay and spatial walk-off; propose compensation if needed.

requirements.requirement: Current focusing worksheet uses an isotropic placeholder n 405=1.85. It is not material certification.
requirements.evidence_requested: Validated refractive/group-index model for 405 and 810 nm, temperature validity, principal axes and anisotropic diffraction terms or equivalent propagation model.

requirements.requirement: Global bench X right,Y up,Z vertical; crystal propagation diagonal in XY. Local u=Z×k,v=Z. Final mount rotation is adjustable.
requirements.evidence_requested: Mark crystallographic X/Y/Z, poling direction, input-face labels, nonlinear pump axis and fast/slow axes; explicitly describe reverse propagation. Do not assume our provisional H/V assignment.

requirements.evidence_requested: CAD/STEP, thermal interfaces, sensor/TEC inclusion, cable exit, clear beam paths from both ends, lead times for both options.

requirements.evidence_requested: Serial certificate and deviations against this RFQ; recommended incoming checks, warranty and remediation if a guaranteed component parameter fails.

rfqs.title: Dual-wavelength PBS for a polarization Sagnac

requirements.requirement: Nominal 405/810 nm, CW pump. Quote at the nominal wavelengths now; final guaranteed bands depend on measured pump and SPDC spectra.
requirements.evidence_requested: Provide full s/p spectral curves over 400-410 and 800-820 nm where available. These are requested characterization spans, not newly imposed operating bandwidths.

requirements.requirement: External faces normal to beam; diagonal coating nominal 45°. Label P1=west,P2=east,P3=north,P4=south. H lies in bench plane; V is vertical.
requirements.evidence_requested: A marked drawing showing coating normal and exact entrance/exit ports. Required routing: P1-H→P2, P1-V→P3; P2-H→P1, P2-V→P4; P3-H→P4, P3-V→P1.

requirements.requirement: Project target ER_T=T_H/T_V≥1000 and ER_R=R_V/R_H≥1000 at both wavelength bands, at every used input direction. Ratios use separately normalized equal incident powers.
requirements.evidence_requested: Guaranteed values for P1,P2,P3 incidence, both outputs and both wavelengths; specify minima, typical values, uncertainty and test conditions. Published family >300:1 does not establish compliance.

requirements.requirement: Report desired throughput T_H,R_V and undesired T_V,R_H independently; low transmission cannot be hidden by a large extinction ratio.
requirements.evidence_requested: Absolute power fractions with absorption/scatter budget and curves. No additional absolute-throughput threshold is frozen before the complete loss budget; quote guaranteed achievable values.

requirements.requirement: The two SPDC alternatives must retain coherent polarization transfer in reverse traversal. Intensity extinction alone is insufficient.
requirements.evidence_requested: Complex Jones coefficients or phase/retardance versus wavelength for transmission/reflection and reverse ports; coating asymmetry, group-delay difference and conventions. State if these are unavailable.

requirements.requirement: Catalog candidate is 12.7 x 12.7 x 12.7 mm; worksheet assumed 10 mm. Clear aperture at least 5 mm on all used faces.
requirements.evidence_requested: Actual glass, cement, index model at 405/810, optical path lengths, tolerances, beam deviation and dimensional CAD. A 10-mm option may be quoted separately, with full specifications.

requirements.requirement: All four beam ports remain accessible; center beam height 75 mm. The old generic 26-mm mount square is not a clearance guarantee.
requirements.evidence_requested: Suitable mount part number/CAD, beam-center offset, required pads/adhesive limits and available adjustment.

requirements.requirement: Normal face incidence nominal; report sensitivity to small alignment errors and laboratory temperature.
requirements.evidence_requested: Provide acceptance angle, s/p behavior, depolarization, wavefront error and coating/adhesive temperature limits; identify tested angles and temperatures.

requirements.requirement: System operates at 0.1-3 mW total incident crystal power; upstream PBS power and accidental exposure depend on actual source.
requirements.evidence_requested: 405-nm CW handling/fluorescence/aging information and maximum permitted incident power; no transfer of a 1064-nm pulsed damage number.

requirements.requirement: If standard PBS0012-405/810 cannot guarantee the target, quote a compliant custom or selected unit and separately report the standard-unit deviation.
requirements.evidence_requested: Serial/lot test data, price/NRE difference, lead time and acceptance/remedy terms. Do not substitute a 405-only or 810-only PBS.

rfqs.title: Dual half-wave plate for405 and810 nm

requirements.requirement: Half-wave at BOTH405 and 810 nm: δ(λ)=π modulo 2π. WPD03-H810-F405 is not an equivalent substitution.
requirements.evidence_requested: Confirm exact order code and retardance at both wavelengths.808/404 variants require a new fit to actual wavelengths.

requirements.requirement: Project target nearest-half-wave phase error≤2π/100 radians (λ/100 retardance) at each operating band, not merely at one catalog center.
requirements.evidence_requested: Guaranteed error and measurement uncertainty at actual wavelengths; provide δ(λ) over 400-410 and 800-820 nm where available, with temperature/AOI stated. Spans are characterization requests, not frozen passbands.

requirements.requirement: Nominal fast-axis angle 45° relative to local H/V. The plate rotates the pump before generation in one direction and the pair after generation in the other.
requirements.evidence_requested: Unwrapped retardance/order integers, fast/slow-axis identification at both wavelengths, marking tolerance and a clearly defined viewing direction.

requirements.requirement: Reverse traversal must be included in the source Jones model. Forward intensity swapping is not sufficient.
requirements.evidence_requested: Forward/reverse Jones description, axis convention and any asymmetric/coating phase; state reciprocity assumptions explicitly.

requirements.requirement: The two photons encounter different polarization histories. A half-wave value modulo 2π does not specify differential delay.
requirements.evidence_requested: dδ/dω or group-delay difference over 810 band, temperature dependence and thickness/material information sufficient for an independent estimate.

requirements.requirement: Catalog candidate: optical diameter 15 mm in 25.4-mm holder. Current worksheet assumes 1 mm optical material, not verified.
requirements.evidence_requested: Actual number/material/thickness of plates and air gaps; thickness tolerances, wedge, clear aperture, holder thickness, optical-center datum and CAD.

requirements.requirement: AR at 405 and 810 for incidence nominal 0°; sufficient clear aperture for the complete beam and adjustment range.
requirements.evidence_requested: Per-face R and total T versus wavelength and polarization, scatter, wavefront and fluorescence data; confirm family specification applies to offered unit.

requirements.requirement: Laboratory use; adjacent crystal oven 20-60 °C does not define the plate temperature. Small alignment tilt must be budgeted.
requirements.evidence_requested: δ sensitivity to angle and temperature, recommended operating limits and axis stability; propose zero-order alternative if bandwidth demands it.

requirements.requirement: One adjustable manual holder for this plate. Nominal 45° is a start setting only.
requirements.evidence_requested: Compatible holder part number and envelope; recommended polarization/retardance calibration and marking inspection.

requirements.requirement: Supplier data must separate guaranteed values from typical or calculated values.
requirements.evidence_requested: Serial/lot certificate, spectral data in CSV, drawings, part revision and acceptance/remedy terms. Price any selected-performance option separately.
